text_block_list.text:
With a magnificent performance, Sweep 
Tosho sent the Yasuda Kinen crowd into a 
frenzy.

The rumor reached Zenno Rob Roy's ears 
during training, igniting her fighting 
spirit.

A witch who perfected her spell, or an 
awakened hero. Who will become the 
protagonist of this story— will be decided 
at the Takarazuka Kinen.
